CREATE FUNCTION reverse_int4_cmp(integer,integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $$SELECT CASE WHEN $1>$2 THEN -1 WHEN $1<$2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END$$

CREATE OPERATOR CLASS reverse_int4_ops FOR TYPE integer USING btree AS OPERATOR 1 >(integer,integer), OPERATOR 2 >=(integer,integer), OPERATOR 3 =(integer,integer), OPERATOR 4 <=(integer,integer), OPERATOR 5 <(integer,integer), FUNCTION 1 reverse_int4_cmp(integer,integer)
CREATE TYPE reverse_window AS RANGE (subtype=integer,subtype_opclass=reverse_int4_ops)

CREATE TABLE reverse_window_comparisons (r reverse_window[] DEFAULT '{"empty","(,)","[3,3]","[3,1)","(3,1]","[3,1]","[2,1]"}', m reverse_window_multirange[] DEFAULT '{"{}","{empty}","{[3,3]}","{[3,1)}","{[3,1]}","{(,)}","{[3,3],[2,1]}"}')
INSERT INTO reverse_window_comparisons DEFAULT VALUES
SELECT adbin::text FROM pg_attrdef WHERE adrelid='reverse_window_comparisons'::regclass ORDER BY adnum

SELECT a.i::integer,b.i::integer,CASE WHEN a.v=b.v THEN 0 WHEN a.v<b.v THEN -1 ELSE 1 END FROM reverse_window_comparisons t CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(t.r) WITH ORDINALITY a(v,i),LATERAL unnest(t.r) WITH ORDINALITY b(v,i) ORDER BY a.i,b.i

SELECT a.i::integer,b.i::integer,CASE WHEN a.v=b.v THEN 0 WHEN a.v<b.v THEN -1 ELSE 1 END FROM reverse_window_comparisons t CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(t.m) WITH ORDINALITY a(v,i),LATERAL unnest(t.m) WITH ORDINALITY b(v,i) ORDER BY a.i,b.i
